# components/banner

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/banner/banner.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { Banner } from "@tundralibs/ui/banner"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/banner.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Banner`

```ts
Banner(props: BannerProps): Html
```

A page-level strip — an announcement, a maintenance window, a plan
nudge — for the top of a page, above or under the navbar (`Alert` is
the in-content notice). One line of centred text, an inline action and
a close button; `storageKey` keeps it dismissed across visits.

## Types

### `BannerVariant`

- `"neutral"`
- `"info"`
- `"success"`
- `"warning"`
- `"danger"`
- `"accent"`

### `BannerProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `variant` | `BannerVariant` |  | Colour. `accent` is the brand strip — a launch, a promotion. @default "neutral" |
| `body` | `string | Html` | yes | The one line (two at most) the strip says. |
| `action` | `{ label: string; href?: string; attrs?: Attrs }` |  | The inline action beside the text — a link when `href` is set, else a button that needs its own `attrs` (`data-action`, `data-modal-open`…). |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` |  | A close button at the end; shared/js/dismiss.js removes the strip. |
| `storageKey` | `string` |  | Remember a dismissal in this browser under this key (localStorage; banner.js hides the strip on later visits). Change the key to show a new notice to people who dismissed the last one. |
| `icon` | `Html | "false"` |  | Leading icon; status variants get one by default. Pass `false` to suppress. |
| `sticky` | `boolean` |  | Stays at the top of the viewport while the page scrolls. |
| `role` | `"status" | "alert" | "none"` |  | How a screen reader announces it: `status` (polite) by default; `alert` interrupts (an outage notice swapped in); `none` renders no live role (a static strip that was on the page from the start). |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### An announcement people can dismiss for good

`storageKey` remembers the dismissal in the browser; change the key for the next announcement.

```ts
Banner({
  variant: "accent",
  body: "Workspaces are here: one account, every team.",
  action: { label: "See what changed", href: "/changelog/workspaces" },
  dismissible: true,
  storageKey: "workspaces-launch",
})
```

```html
<div class="banner banner--accent" role="status" data-banner="" data-banner-key="workspaces-launch" data-dismissible="" hidden="">
  <div class="banner__inner">
    <span class="banner__body">Workspaces are here: one account, every team.</span>
    <a class="banner__action" href="/changelog/workspaces">See what changed</a>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="banner__close" data-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

### A maintenance notice that stays in view

```ts
Banner({
  variant: "warning",
  sticky: true,
  body: "Read-only until 03:00 UTC while we move the database.",
  action: { label: "Status page", href: "https://status.acme.com" },
})
```

```html
<div class="banner banner--warning banner--sticky" role="status" data-banner="">
  <div class="banner__inner">
    <span class="banner__icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
    <span class="banner__body">Read-only until 03:00 UTC while we move the database.</span>
    <a class="banner__action" href="https://status.acme.com">Status page</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

`.banner`, `.banner--accent`, `.banner--danger`, `.banner--info`, `.banner--sticky`, `.banner--success`, `.banner--warning`, `.banner__action`, `.banner__body`, `.banner__close`, `.banner__icon`, `.banner__inner`

## Behaviour

`components/banner/banner.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-banner`, `data-banner-key`, `data-dismiss`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
